name: vibeprospecting-sourcing
description: Vibe Prospecting Sourcing: Find candidates & talent data.

interface.longDescription:
Vibe Prospecting Sourcing brings live professional data into ChatGPT for recruiting and talent intelligence. It draws on 800M+ professional profiles and 150M+ companies aggregated from 50+ sources, so you can turn a role brief into a candidate pipeline without leaving the conversation.

Source candidates from a brief. Paste a job description or describe the role in plain language. The plugin turns it into a search for the current title, adjacent titles, seniority, department, skills, location, total experience and time in current role. Results come back as a structured list you can refine and export.

Map the talent bench. See how many people work in a function at your target or competitor companies, who leads each team, and how the teams are structured. Compare companies side by side to find the deepest benches.

Spot movable talent. Track layoffs, restructuring, acquisitions, leadership changes, shrinking departments and recent role changes, so you can find teams where people may be open to a move and time your outreach.

Research a candidate. Look up a specific person by name and company to see their work history, tenure, prior employers and skills before a screen.

Get contact details when you're ready. Get verified work emails and phone numbers for shortlisted candidates, check emails you already have, and export a clean list to your ATS or outreach tool.

Who it's for. In-house recruiters and talent acquisition teams, agency recruiters, sourcers, hiring managers and talent intelligence teams.

Hiring fairly. The plugin matches only on job-related evidence. It does not filter or score on age, gender, ethnicity, nationality or other protected characteristics.

Try prompts like:

"Find 30 senior backend engineers in Berlin with Go and Kubernetes experience."
"Here's a JD for a VP Sales. Build me a candidate pipeline."
"Map the data engineering teams at Snowflake, Databricks and Confluent."
"Which fintech companies had layoffs in engineering in the last 6 months?"
"Find product designers 2 to 4 years into their current role at Series B+ startups in NYC."
"Show me the work history of Jane Doe at Stripe."
"Get verified emails for these 15 shortlisted candidates."
"Where can we hire ML engineers from? Rank companies by talent depth and movement signals."

Vibe Prospecting Sourcing is built on Explorium's B2B data platform. Data is retrieved live when you ask, not from a static export, so results reflect current profiles.

Map the data engineering teams at our top 5 competitors
Build a candidate pipeline for a VP Sales in New York

positive.description: Source candidates by title, level and location.
positive.prompt: Autocomplete job_title for 'backend engineer', then find 20 prospects with that job_title, job_level senior, located in Germany, and show a sample
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a sample of senior backend engineers based in Germany.

positive.description: Source candidates and enrich work history.
positive.prompt: Autocomplete job_title for 'product designer', find 20 prospects with that job_title in the US, call enrich-prospects with the profiles enrichment to get their work history and tenure, then show a sample
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a sample of product designers with enriched work history and tenure.

positive.description: Map a function's headcount at a known company.
positive.prompt: Match the company with domain snowflake.com, then get statistics on how many prospects there are in the engineering department by job_level
positive.expected_behavior: Returns aggregate counts of Snowflake engineering employees broken down by seniority.

positive.description: Find movement signals at source companies.
positive.prompt: Match companies with domains stripe.com and plaid.com, call fetch-businesses-events for cost_cutting and decrease_in_engineering_department in the last 180 days, and show a sample
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a sample of recent layoff or department-decrease events for the matched companies.

positive.description: Get contact details for candidates at a known company.
positive.prompt: Match the company with domain gong.io, find 15 prospects in the engineering department at manager level or above, call enrich-prospects to get their email, then show a sample
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a sample of gong.io engineering managers with enriched email values.

negative.description: Do not trigger for filtering candidates on protected characteristics.
negative.prompt: Find software engineers under 30 who are women, based on their graduation year and first name.

negative.description: Do not trigger for posting a job or sending outreach.
negative.prompt: Post this job description to LinkedIn and email it to all applicants.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general career advice.
negative.prompt: How should I prepare for a software engineering interview?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Vibe Prospecting is a B2B data service used through the user's existing account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Vibe Prospecting Sourcing: a recruiting-focused package built on the Vibe Prospecting MCP connection, with talent sourcing, bench mapping, candidate research and contact enrichment skills.
